persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: These are photos of my café. Make a cosy 9-second vertical Instagram reel using all three, storefront first. Gentle movement, soft upbeat music, no talking. Put “Maple Street Café” at the start and “Your morning starts here” at the end.
bank.Business and exact wording: Maple Street Café; opening text: Maple Street Café; closing text: Your morning starts here.
bank.Photos and order: Use all three attached photos. Start with the storefront; the order of the latte and pastries is your call.
bank.Style and movement: Cosy, warm and inviting, with gentle movement. Transition choices are your call.
bank.Audio and language: Soft upbeat music, no talking. English text.

messages.text: These are photos of my café—the storefront pic, the latte pic, and the pastries pic—and I’d like you to make something cosy, warm and inviting with all three. I’m really fond of the place, and it feels lovely to have these little glimpses of it to share. What I have in mind is a vertical 9:16 Instagram reel, 9 seconds long, with the storefront first, and you can choose whether the latte or pastries comes next. Please use gentle movement, with whatever transitions you think work, and soft upbeat music with no talking. For the English text, put “Maple Street Café” at the start and “Your morning starts here” at the end.
